container_contract.distribution: Debian trixie inside the declared Ubuntu24.04 hosted VM
container_contract.reason: The frozen study reads memory.max/current/events/stat at /sys/fs/cgroup. Linux exposes these interfaces for non-root groups; a job container supplies a real private cgroup namespace instead of assuming the bare VM root has them. The guard and scientific source stay unchanged.

container_observation_scope: The actual hosted runner will read /etc/os-release, /.dockerenv, /proc/self/cgroup, cgroup namespace link and required cgroup interfaces. It verifies exact Python/dependency versions, 8 GiB memory.max, zero swap and two-CPU quota. Image digest is bound to public plan/workflow, not independently attested by inside-container observations.
fixture_storage: Temporary unit-test inputs and child logs were deleted by TemporaryDirectory cleanup; summarized actual wait4 observations are coordinator-test evidence, not formal research/native raw receipts.

interface_review.source_hash_scope: 124 frozen Python/baseline sources plus separately listed hosted/*.py, workflow, plan, design and execution-binding plan. Dynamic HOSTED_PROTOCOL is excluded from the immutable extra-source map.
